environment.description: Kubernetes 1.27 cluster on EKS with default namespace. Pod runs as privileged container with hostPath volume mount to /proc. No PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurity admission controller configured. Container image runs as root (UID 0). The allocator is glibc 2.35 default malloc. No seccomp profile applied (runtime/default is unconfined for privileged). Service exposed via NodePort.
